result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: a major layout/content cut-off in the Popular section and a minor truncated restaurant name in the horizontal carousel.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section (pizza image with '-20%' badge) is significantly cut off at the bottom of the screen, showing only the top portion of the image and no restaurant name, time, or delivery info.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the card container has sufficient height or padding so that content is not clipped by the viewport/bottom navigation, or allow the page to scroll to reveal the full card.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll, the third restaurant name appears truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol' with the rest of the name cut off.
issues.suggestion: Allow the card to expand its width or use text truncation with an ellipsis to properly indicate a clipped name, and ensure the full name is visible either on the card or on detail view.
